newsitem.title: USA: Cia Brasileira makes NYSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Cia Brasileira makes NYSE debut.

text.p: Brazilian food retailer Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao rose in its New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) debut Thursday.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in the company were up 7/8 from an offering price of 20. Volume in mid-morning was 1.1 million ADRs, putting the company on the exchange's most-active list.
Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao is the biggest food retailer in Brazil. It is often known as Pao de Acucar, for one of its chains.
The company is selling 7.5 million ADRs in a global offering. Each ADR represents 1,000 preferred shares, or 11 percent of outstanding shares.
Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao is the fourth Brazilian company to list on the NYSE.
The global coordinators and lead managers for the offering are Merrill Lynch, BBA Creditanstalt and Paribas.
